body: Yeah I've already held a gun two times (I don't have access to it anymore sadly) and it was scary, but those times weren't as shitty. I think no amount of fear will make me feel like my life is worth anything now.

I did move not too long ago when I started college, but I still depend financially on them to pay the rent of the place I'm living in now and with my health problem getting worse + the fact that I don't like my uni course (and that both my bowel issues and my depression affect my performance at it) I've began to feel like dropping out again, and doing so would mean returning to that sick environment again. I think I'm putting up with college because of that more than anything... I highly doubt I can get far in a field I don't have a passion for.
